items.excerpt: AI Gateway can now run video generation as a background job, with three ways to wait for it: a webhook, a start-and-status pair, or short polling. Long-running generative video finally fits inside normal product code paths.
Alibaba's Wan 3.0 lands on Vercel AI Gateway, generating up to 30 seconds of video with audio from text, image, video and audio references — no separate vendor account required.

Run SDK executes untrusted JavaScript and TypeScript generated by agents without giving it access to your application, and can pause mid-run for human approval — a guardrail layer for prompt-to-app tools.

A prompt box is the visible center of an image-to-image tool, but it is not the product boundary. The piece argues generative UI should expose a capability contract — what the model can and cannot honor — instead of a blank text field.
Real restaurant menus generated with AI image tools are wiping out the hand-made vernacular of local graphic design, replacing it with uncanny, mangled illustration.
Artists spot generative-AI artefacts in Masters of the Universe promo art, the latest studio campaign to be accused of quietly shipping AI-made key art.
Audiences are lining up for deliberately rough, hand-made cartoons — a backlash aesthetic that says as much about how people now read AI-smooth visuals as it does about animation itself.
CG Channel's weekly roundup covers Meshy 7, new Slapshot ComfyUI nodes and Postshot updates — the AI-adjacent releases that slipped past most 3D pipelines this week.
Smart Remesh is a context-aware Blender add-on that turns both organic characters and hard-surface models into clean quad geometry while preserving vertex positions.

Miris CTO Sean Looper explains spatial streaming: one 3D source file adaptively delivered to any device, the way adaptive video streaming solved playback — a potential unlock for heavy 3D and splat assets on the web.
Patterned Glass Compositor is a free Blender tool for customizable glass distortion and refraction, usable live in-scene or added in post.
Instagram's new First Draft feature auto-trims raw clips into a rough Reels cut, taking the busywork out of short-form editing before a creator ever opens a timeline.

Anthropic unified Claude's memory across chat and Cowork agent sessions, with more granular controls over what gets saved — meaning project context now follows you between conversation and agentic file work.
NVIDIA brings its next wave of RTX rendering and neural graphics tech to Gamescom, with publishers adopting new visual-quality and anti-cheat technologies built on RTX Spark.
MillworkSuite's new AI platform converts architectural PDF drawings into priced scopes and CAD-ready cabinet layouts, collapsing the estimating-to-drafting handoff for millwork shops.
Digital-twin maker 51WORLD unveiled two embodied-AI products, pushing simulation environments toward training and validating physical robots rather than just visualizing them.
From a DIY duck house to luxury glamping pods: how Armadilla uses CAD-driven product development to give outdoor accommodation a sustainable upgrade.
Every website peaks on launch day and drifts from there. Pierre Burgy makes the case for autonomous websites continuously optimized by agents after launch — and what breaks when you try to build one.

A newly granted Arm patent describes a headset that analyzes motion in the images headed to the display and fires ultrasonic transducers at the wearer's vestibular system to suppress VR motion sickness.
ByteDance's Pico has postponed the reveal and release of 'Project Swan', its long-teased Apple Vision Pro competitor, cancelling a September event.
Everything known so far about Project Phoenix, Meta's next headset — the display, optics and interaction decisions that will set the constraints for the next generation of spatial app design.
Apple's new Mac Studio with M5 Max and the all-new M5 Ultra promises a large leap in on-device AI performance and graphics — the desk-side machine studios use to run local models and heavy 3D.
Much as GPS eroded our navigation instincts, leaning on chatbots appears to weaken our ability to judge what's true — a warning for teams outsourcing first-pass thinking to AI.
Great prompts can spark AI adoption, but it's platform teams — shared tooling, guardrails, evals — that turn scattered experiments into trusted capability across an organization.
AI Jason argues the prompt is no longer the unit of work: instead of prompting agents turn by turn, he sets up environments, specs and loops the agent runs against on its own.
Matt Wolfe demos an AI world-generation tool that spins up explorable 3D environments from a prompt — the kind of capability that reframes concepting for spatial and game work.
Adobe walks through Photoshop's Selection tool, the AI-assisted successor to the old lasso-and-refine dance for isolating subjects.
